veteran.name: Lattice Corps Veteran
veteran.desc: You served as a linked operator in the Concord's war for Haldis Reach, until the war ended or you walked away. Crew and officers still read the posture.
veteran.benefit: +2 Awareness; 2 military trauma packs; crew-facing dialogue options (Iona, Commander Varr).

colonist.name: Haldis Native
colonist.desc: You were born under Haldis Reach's amber sky, recruited into the operator program young, and you are leaving home on a Concord ship. The reclaimers boarding it speak your dialect.
colonist.benefit: +2 Persuasion; extra credits and a Haldis kinship token; reclaimer-facing dialogue options (Senna, Marshal Quill, the Venn family).

salvager.name: Breaker-Yard Salvager
salvager.desc: After the operator program you spent years cutting apart warships in orbital breaker yards. You understand machines, including the synthetic ones that want to be understood.
salvager.benefit: +2 Repair; technical components and tech gauntlets; machine-facing dialogue options (Tav-7, engineering).
